label: Amazon US
notes: Marketplace policy: no promotional or pricing language, no special characters in the title, no unverifiable superlatives.

label: Amazon DE
notes: Use formal 'Sie' only if addressing the reader. Use metric units and German decimal comma.

label: Amazon ES
notes: Marketplace policy: no promotional or pricing language, no special characters in the title, no unverifiable superlatives. Use 'tú' form consistently. Metric units and the Spanish decimal comma.

label: Rakuten JP
notes: Marketplace policy: Rakuten listings are conventionally long and benefit-rich (longer titles and descriptions than Amazon JP), but still no promotional/pricing language or unverifiable superlatives. Use polite です/ます form. Metric units.
